page: Amazon Web Services c6gd.2xlarge is a compute-optimized instance powered by an AWS Graviton processor using the 64-bit ARM architecture. It features 8 dedicated physical cores and 8 vCPUs running at 2.5 GHz on the Neoverse-N1 microarchitecture. The hardware configuration includes 16.0 GB of system memory, providing a 2.0 GB per core ratio, and is equipped with 474 GB of local NVMe SSD instance storage. Network connectivity is rated at a baseline bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

In benchmark evaluations, the instance demonstrates average multi-core CPU performance, with a stress-ng multi-core score of 12133.14 and a Geekbench multi-core score of 5364.0. Single-core performance is comparatively lower, as indicated by a Geekbench single-core score of 930.0 and a weak Passmark CPU score of 5242.38. Cryptographic performance is limited, with a poor Passmark CPU encryption score of 1084.81, though the processor supports hardware-accelerated AES. Memory bandwidth is a notable strength, reaching 473.11 GB/sec for cached small-block reads and 116.89 GB/sec for uncached large-block reads.

The inclusion of local NVMe SSD storage makes this instance highly suitable for workloads requiring low-latency scratch space or high-speed temporary storage. It achieves an average of 9.43 million operations per second in Redis SET benchmarks and 9.78 GB/sec in static web serving throughput. However, the lack of advanced vector extensions (AVX) and specialized matrix instructions limits its utility for complex mathematical modeling or heavy machine learning tasks, as reflected in the weak LLM text generation speeds.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ARM64-based Graviton architecture offers a favorable balance of dedicated physical cores and local NVMe storage relative to its resource footprint. This makes the c6gd.2xlarge an efficient choice for scale-out workloads, web serving, software compilation, and database operations that benefit from local SSD performance without requiring high memory-to-vCPU ratios.
description: Amazon Web Services c6gd.2xlarge is a compute-optimized, ARM64-based instance powered by an 8-core AWS Graviton Neoverse-N1 processor running at 2.5 GHz. It features 16.0 GB of system memory and 474 GB of local NVMe SSD storage, operating on the Nitro hypervisor with a 2 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. Benchmark data shows average multi-core performance, with a Geekbench multi-core score of 5364.0 and strong cached memory read bandwidth of 473.11 GB/sec, though single-core and cryptographic performance are relatively weak. Lacking AVX and AMX extensions, it is less suited for heavy vector math or LLM inference. However, the combination of dedicated physical cores and high-speed local storage makes this instance highly efficient for web serving, software compilation, Redis deployments, and database workloads requiring fast local scratch space.
